phase_commits.subject: Phase 149O.1J: HATP Verification Engine Independent Verification (Wave 4)

recommended_next_phase: Optional narrow 149O.1J.1 -- repair the repository-authority lookup-ordering imprecision found this phase (a proof replayed against a repository_id with no trust-store authority record resolves to UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER rather than WRONG_REPOSITORY, because lookup_authority is keyed on the proof's own repository_id before the explicit current_repository_id equality check; still fails closed in every case, diagnostic-precision repair only, not a security defect). Otherwise, 149O.2 -- Wave 5 (real HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1-conformant provider: FIDO2 primary, PIV fallback, implementing the HATPProofVerifierProvider interface Wave 4 already defines), still without production RAE/Permission-Broker wiring (Wave 6/7).
summary: Phase 149O.1J -- HATP Verification Engine Independent Verification: independently verified (without trusting 149O.1I's own report or the implementation's own claims) that the Wave-4 HATP verification engine (verify_hatp_proof, inspect_hatp_verification_substrate_readiness, HATPVerificationStatus, HATPVerificationResult in src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py and src/pcae/core/hatp_providers.py) correctly implements HATP-001 v1.0's verification state machine. Read HATP-001 (HATP-REQ-001..117) in full and independently re-derived the Wave-4 requirement set. Independently re-typed HATP-REQ-078's closed 13-state vocabulary by hand from the contract text (not copied from the implementation) and confirmed exact 13/13 equality with HATPVerificationStatus, plus disjointness from the Permission Broker vocabulary and near-total disjointness from RAE-001's vocabulary (overlap limited to the two shared common words VALID/MISSING, which HATP-REQ-078 does not forbid). Independently reconstructed verify_hatp_proof's full 17-step check-sequence state machine by direct source inspection. Wrote a new independent adversarial test suite, tests/test_phase_149o_1j_hatp_verification_engine_independent_verification.py (77 tests, all passing), with its own independently-constructed test harness (not imported from 149O.1I's own test file) covering: exact status vocabulary and disjointness; the success conjunction and a full one-fact-removed matrix (15 dedicated tests, each removing exactly one HATP-REQ-079 conjunctive fact); multi-failure/triple-failure precedence determinism (5 repeated evaluations per scenario, single distinct result each); provider-exception and unknown-provider-result mapping to INVALID_SIGNATURE; trust-store-exception mapping to MISSING at every call site (environment_status, lookup_signer, lookup_principal/lookup_authority) via a hand-built raising fake store; provider-profile-mismatch mapping to UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER; clock-skew/freshness boundary tests at -1s/0s/+59.999s/+60s/+60.001s (all pass, boundary itself at +60.000s remains VALID under the implementation's strict-greater-than comparison) plus an AST-based (docstring-excluded) confirmation that verify_hatp_proof's executable body contains no datetime.now()/.utcnow()/time.time() call and that evaluation_time is a required keyword-only parameter; canonical byte-exact equality via an instrumented provider seam diffed against canonicalize_hatp_proof_payload(proof); a full signed-field mutation matrix independently re-derived from hatp_proof_to_document(proof).keys() at test-collection time (not hardcoded from 149O.1I's own parametrization list) -- every field mutation with stale evidence fails closed, verified against its ACTUAL resulting status (UNKNOWN_SIGNER/UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER for the three identity-binding fields checked before signature verification, INVALID_SIGNATURE for every other field, since a blanket INVALID_SIGNATURE assumption for the identity fields was independently disproven during this phase's own test development and corrected before this report); replay attacks across repository (including a genuine two-enrolled-repository HATP-REQ-081 scenario, not merely an unenrolled-repository scenario), operation, principal, provider-profile, binding, decision-digest (confirmed VALID, an intentional documented Wave-6 scope deferral, not a gap), and time, each with a freshly re-signed proof to isolate the semantic check from the mutation matrix's signature-staleness dimension; current-state revocation (signer/authority/deployment-binding revoked in the trust store AFTER proof/evidence creation, re-verified WITHOUT regenerating the proof, confirming HATP-REQ-088's consumption-time semantic is genuinely enforced); test-provider containment (grepped all of src/pcae/**/*.py, TestHATPProofVerifierProvider referenced only inside its own defining module hatp_providers.py; AST-confirmed not imported by human_approval_trusted_provenance.py); substrate-readiness hard-ceiling fuzzing (signature inspection confirming no operational/force/override/provider/bypass parameter exists; a maximally 'healthy' trust store still yields NOT_READY/operational=False because provider_profile_available/provider_attestation_trusted are permanently hardcoded False; adversarial environment-variable injection across four plausible bypass variable names has no effect; HATPVerificationSubstrateStatus confirmed to have exactly one member, NOT_READY); zero-production-call-site re-confirmation (grepped all of src/pcae/**/*.py for verify_hatp_proof/inspect_hatp_verification_substrate_readiness -- zero call sites outside human_approval_trusted_provenance.py itself; explicitly re-checked rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker.py, permission_broker_foundation.py, agent.py, commands/agent.py -- zero references to any Wave-4 symbol in any of them); and an AST-based (not merely regex/docstring-excluded) confirmation of zero approval_present assignment anywhere in human_approval_trusted_provenance.py's executable code. Disposed all three of 149O.1I's carried-over OBSERVATIONs (failure precedence is a documented non-normative choice per HATP-REQ-079's unordered-AND-list phrasing; 60-second clock-skew tolerance is a documented non-normative value per HATP-REQ-085; provider-profile-mismatch/provider-exception status mapping has no dedicated vocabulary name and both choices independently confirmed fail-closed) as CONFIRMED CORRECT / NON-BLOCKING -- none simply disappeared. Surfaced one new, previously undocumented finding, disposed as NON-BLOCKING: a proof replayed with a freshly-valid signature against a repository_id that has NO trust-store authority record at all resolves to UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER rather than WRONG_REPOSITORY, because verify_hatp_proof's trust_store.lookup_authority(signer.principal_id, proof.repository_id) call is keyed on the proof's OWN repository_id and executes before the explicit proof.repository_id != current_repository_id equality check; this still fails closed in every case (never VALID), and the actual HATP-REQ-081/082 mandatory-attack-#12 scenario (a proof valid for one enrolled repository replayed against a DIFFERENT, also-enrolled repository) was independently confirmed to correctly return WRONG_REPOSITORY once a second repository is genuinely enrolled in the trust store, isolating this from the unenrolled-repository case. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_1J_HATP_VERIFICATION_ENGINE_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md covering initial state, diff reconstruction, independent requirement re-derivation, vocabulary reconstruction/diff, state-machine reconstruction, success conjunction/one-fact-removed matrix, multi-failure precedence, all three observation dispositions, trust-state binding, cryptographic payload boundary, mutation matrix, replay attacks, provider/trust-store failure handling, freshness/skew analysis, current-state revocation, operational readiness separation, call-site audit, no-approval/no-execution boundary, full regression results, findings, verdicts, and recommended next phase. Regression, all actually re-run this phase (not assumed from 149O.1I's own claimed counts): 149O.1I's own Wave-4 suite (tests/test_hatp_verification_engine.py) 59 passed, exact match to 149O.1I's claim; this phase's new independent suite 77 passed; Wave-1/2 (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py) 40 passed; combined HATP + 149O.1-family (-k 'hatp or 149o_1', includes this phase's new file) 1405 passed / 2 skipped, 0 failed; report-trust (test_phase_reports.py + test_phase_reports_cli.py + test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py) 187 passed; RAE canonical-provenance suite run directly 4 failed / 13 passed (same 4 known pre-existing B-149O-1..4 forgery findings, still OPEN per HATP-REQ-105/106, unaffected by and unrelated to this phase); Permission Broker suites (test_permission_broker.py + test_permission_broker_foundation.py, -n auto) 295 passed, exact match to 149O.1I's claim; Permission-Broker consumer-scope-inventory same pre-existing false-positive already present via hatp_bootstrap.py's own docstring prose (unaffected); Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto) 4589 passed / 1 failed (test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewCreate::test_create_persists_to_latest, confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to HATP/this phase's zero src/pcae/ changes); test_agent.py (4236 tests, -n auto) result recorded in validation_results below. Files changed this phase: tests/test_phase_149o_1j_hatp_verification_engine_independent_verification.py (new, 77 tests), docs/PHASE_149O_1J_HATP_VERIFICATION_ENGINE_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md (new), PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, .pcae/phase-completion-report.md, .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json, plus task-lifecycle files -- zero files under src/pcae/ or docs/contracts/ changed (independently git-status-confirmed at close). VERIFICATION STATE MACHINE: CONFORMS. TRUST BINDING: CONFORMS. CRYPTOGRAPHIC PAYLOAD BOUNDARY: CONFORMS. PER-PROOF VALIDITY: CONFORMS. OVERALL WAVE-4 VERDICT: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. HATP PRODUCTION: NOT READY (unchanged -- still absent: real hardware signer, real device attestation, Class-B OS deployment provisioning, RAE/HATP production integration, AG3/AG5 Permission Broker wiring, approval_present=True derivation). Recommended next phase: optional narrow 149O.1J.1 repair, otherwise 149O.2 (Wave 5, real hardware provider).

validation_results.name: canonical_payload_byte_exact_boundary
validation_results.result: Instrumented provider seam captured the exact bytes passed to provider.verify(canonical_payload=...); diffed against an independently-computed canonicalize_hatp_proof_payload(proof) call at the test site: byte-exact equality confirmed.

validation_results.name: mutation_matrix_independently_derived_field_set
validation_results.result: Signed-field set independently re-derived from hatp_proof_to_document(proof).keys() at test-collection time (not hardcoded from 149O.1I's own parametrization), cross-checked equal to the tested set. Every field's single-field stale-evidence mutation fails closed, verified against its ACTUAL resulting status: principal_id/signer_key_id -> UNKNOWN_SIGNER, provider_profile -> UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER (all three caught by identity-binding checks BEFORE signature verification), every other field (repository_id, decision_record_id/digest, binding_id/digest, issued_at, job_id, original_commit_sha) -> INVALID_SIGNATURE. This phase's own first test draft incorrectly assumed a blanket INVALID_SIGNATURE for all fields; disproven and corrected before this report, recorded as a positive finding about the engine's defense-in-depth, not a defect. AG3-family/AG5-family mismatch with stale evidence also independently confirmed INVALID_SIGNATURE.

validation_results.name: replay_attacks_all_named_dimensions
validation_results.result: Freshly re-signed replay across repository (unenrolled -> UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER, finding below; two genuinely enrolled repositories -> WRONG_REPOSITORY, the correct HATP-REQ-081 scenario), operation/decision (-> WRONG_OPERATION), principal (-> UNKNOWN_SIGNER), provider-profile (-> UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER), binding (-> WRONG_OPERATION), decision-digest-alone (-> VALID, confirmed as an intentional documented Wave-6 scope deferral per 149O.1I Sec 9, not a gap), time (-> EXPIRED), same-ID-wrong-deployment (-> WRONG_DEPLOYMENT), deployment-binding-for-different-signer (-> WRONG_DEPLOYMENT).

validation_results.name: current_state_revocation_at_consumption_time
validation_results.result: Baseline VALID confirmed first for each scenario, then signer/authority/deployment-binding independently revoked in the live trust store AFTER proof/evidence creation, re-verified WITHOUT regenerating the proof: signer revocation -> REVOKED_SIGNER, authority revocation -> UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER, deployment-binding revocation -> WRONG_DEPLOYMENT. Confirms HATP-REQ-088's consumption-time semantic is genuinely enforced against live state, not cached from creation time.

validation_results.name: observation_1_failure_precedence_disposition
validation_results.result: CONFIRMED CORRECT / NON-BLOCKING. HATP-REQ-079 states the VALID conjunction as an unordered AND-list, not a mandated failure order. Independently re-confirmed deterministic across repeated calls.

validation_results.name: observation_2_clock_skew_tolerance_disposition
validation_results.result: CONFIRMED CORRECT / NON-BLOCKING. HATP-REQ-085 requires an implementation-defined tolerance without freezing a value. Independently re-verified exact boundary behavior (see freshness_clock_skew_boundary_matrix above).

validation_results.name: observation_3_provider_profile_mismatch_and_provider_exception_disposition
validation_results.result: CONFIRMED CORRECT / NON-BLOCKING. The closed 13-state vocabulary has no dedicated name for either specific cause; both choices independently re-confirmed fail-closed in every tested scenario.

validation_results.name: new_finding_repository_authority_lookup_ordering
validation_results.result: NON-BLOCKING. A proof replayed with a fresh valid signature against a repository_id with NO trust-store authority record resolves to UNAUTHORIZED_SIGNER rather than WRONG_REPOSITORY, because lookup_authority(signer.principal_id, proof.repository_id) is keyed on the proof's own repository_id and executes before the explicit current_repository_id equality check. Still fails closed in every case (never VALID). The actual HATP-REQ-081/082 mandatory-attack-#12 scenario (replay against a DIFFERENT, also-enrolled repository) independently confirmed to correctly return WRONG_REPOSITORY. No repair performed this phase (verification-only); recommended as an optional narrow 149O.1J.1 follow-up for diagnostic precision only.
